verdict.rationale: New Relic AI is documented as a built-in assistant that lets users ask questions in plain language, troubleshoot, and explore telemetry, and even help construct/debug NRQL queries — a clear in-product AI delegate. Additional evidence of an agentic vulnerability-management agent that triages CVEs, drafts remediations, and opens tickets, plus messaging about moving 'beyond assistance to automated remediation,' shows real task delegation beyond simple Q&A. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the assistant's real-world reliability and depth of autonomous task execution (community evidence covers pricing/UI/logging issues, not the AI assistant specifically).
